## Status at a Glance

| Capability | Status | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PostgreSQL evidence/proposal/admission runtime | **UNRELEASED IMPLEMENTED THROUGH `000058`; SELECTED LAB GATE COMPLETE** | Global Lab v1.0 remains migration `000050`. Migration 57 adds first-capture manual profiles; 58 adds independent references authority, totaling 93 tables. A and B pass separate frozen-source Lab gates. B final focused normal/race each pass 137 events; full normal/race each pass 5,768 events, 17 named optional skips, zero failures/race warnings. No deployment claim |
| Detective-to-MCP source handoff | **IMMUTABLE CHECKPOINT/RESUME IMPLEMENTED; SCOPED SYNTHETIC NORMAL/RACE PASS; FULL PRODUCT OPEN** | Exactly one validated row/candidate is saved before writes; resume uses saved bytes without source-file/model access and requires exact pending Query readback. Frozen 34-/411-input proof passes 357 Detective / 60 focused PG-plus-helper events per mode. Earlier 25-/410-file synthetic proof and 409-file full PG gates remain historical. Full-product recovery, real provider/model, review, admission and named deployment remain open; no Pouch integration |
| Reviewable ingestion handoff | **UNRELEASED IMPLEMENTED, EXPOSED IN AHE-WRAP CODE/STDIO WIRE; UNIVERSAL GOVERNED RUNTIME OPEN** | [`reviewable-ingestion/v1`](reviewable_ingestion_protocol_experiment_20260904.md) supplies the complete batch and exact review subject; [`REVIEW-01A/01B`](reviewable_ingestion_admission_gate_experiment_20260904.md) emits bounded content-addressed display bytes and atomically persists the exact reviewed subject/display. `get_source_claim_review` and `admit_reviewed_source_claim` are registered in the current 42-tool ingestion registry. Focused transport, migration-55, actual non-owner stdio-writer and final full-source normal/race proofs pass. A controller-relayed actual extractor/reviewer simulation retains exact cards, three policy decisions and native readback. MCP's selected native ordinary/exact-reviewed source-admission bundles independently pass their target gates. Legacy writers remain, so universal cutover, authenticated human identity, proof that a human rendered/read the card, named deployment and full Core-to-MCP parity remain OPEN |
| Source-backed claim admission | **IMPLEMENTED, EXPOSED** | explicit review-disposition metadata is required before mutation; launcher identity is recorded, but human review is not authenticated or proven |
| Bounded derived admission | **IMPLEMENTED, EXPOSED** | stdio `admit_pending_proposal` accepts one reviewed complete AND-parent declaration; launcher identity remains authoritative |
| Bounded candidate admission | **IMPLEMENTED, EXPOSED** | the same tool accepts a mutually exclusive fixed `candidate` declaration and creates one fresh candidate plus exact derivation/parent edges; exact Query reads type it as `canonical_candidate`, while Grounded Evidence Brief v2-v6 excludes it before ranking and limit |
| Canonical contradiction admission | **IMPLEMENTED, EXPOSED** | the same tool accepts a mutually exclusive empty `contradiction` arm for the exact normalized claim pair frozen in the proposal; one single-use edge, decision, and manifest commit atomically, while Grounded Evidence Brief excludes relation proposals before ranking and limit |
| Canonical `implements` relation | **UNRELEASED IMPLEMENTED IN CORE; EXPOSED IN AHE-WRAP** | [Recursive v2](recursive_derived_implements_admission_20260906.md) retains native v1 compatibility, complete AND/cycle checks and exact per-layer review/receipt authority. [Supersession origins](implements_supersession_origin_20260906.md) and [first-capture manual profiles](manual_review_profile_experiment_20260906.md) now qualify additional source leaves; arbitrary metadata does not. Code endpoints require verified repository facts. Unsupported profiles, source-v2/legacy overlays, authentication, deployment and AHE-MCP remain separate. No semantic truth/inference/SAT claim |
| Canonical `references` relation | **UNRELEASED IMPLEMENTED, EXPOSED; SELECTED LAB GATE COMPLETE** | [Reviewed writer](canonical_references_experiment_20260906.md): qualified manual/external source claims, exact anchors, complete observed cut, separate receipt, directed-pair single-use and historical replay. Final focused PG/stdio normal/race each pass 137 events; full normal/race each pass 5,768. Cycles are permitted; no support/currentness/automatic revision movement or ordinary provider URLs |
| Ordinary admission integrity | **IMPLEMENTED** | migration `000047` records exact ordered manifests/bindings, enforces append-only mutation and one first-materializer authority, rejects semantic JSONB drift, and fails closed on pre-contract ordinary admissions |
